    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ActivityAnalytics
    Provides estimates of active and idle time within a telemetry session.
    ActivitySummary
    Immutable summary of editor activity within a telemetry session.
    AnalyticsSummary
    Stores aggregate analytics for a telemetry session.
    BackgroundExporter
    Executes telemetry snapshot exports asynchronously and writes matching JSON and PDF files to a configured output directory.
    BlueJClassListener
    Receives BlueJ class events and updates the class inventory or publishes telemetry for class state changes.
    BlueJClassScanner
    Scans BlueJ projects and packages to synchronize class inventory and editor listener registrations.
    BlueJCompileListener
    Receives BlueJ compilation events and publishes corresponding telemetry.
    BlueJEditorListener
    Receives text-edit notifications from a BlueJ Java editor and publishes editor-activity telemetry for the associated class.
    BlueJExecutionListener
    Receives BlueJ invocation-completion events and publishes program-run telemetry, with an additional runtime-exception event for exception exits.
    BlueJMethodScanner
    Scans BlueJ projects, packages, and compiled classes to track declared method signatures in the method inventory.
    BlueJPackageListener
    Receives BlueJ package lifecycle events and coordinates inventory scans, method cleanup, and package telemetry publication.
    ClassInventoryTracker
    Tracks class names by package key and publishes telemetry when class creation, deletion, or renaming is detected.
    CommandInvoker
    Invokes export commands by executing the command supplied to this invoker.
    DemoMain
    Demonstrates telemetry collection, summary calculation, and JSON/PDF export with sample events outside a running BlueJ extension.
    EditorListenerRegistry
    Tracks document-listener registrations for BlueJ classes, grouped by package key, to prevent duplicate attachment and support package cleanup.
    EventType
    Identifies the category of a telemetry event generated during a BlueJ session.
    ExportCommand
    Represents an export operation that can be executed by a command invoker.
    ExportService
    Provides a configurable context for exporting telemetry sessions using an interchangeable export strategy.
    ExportStrategy
    Strategy contract for exporting a telemetry session to a destination file.
    JsonExportCommand
    Export command that writes a telemetry session using the JSON export strategy.
    JsonExportStrategy
    Exports telemetry sessions as formatted JSON, enriched with compilation interval and editor-activity analytics.
    MethodInventoryTracker
    Tracks declared method signatures for each class in a package directory and publishes telemetry when method additions or removals are detected.
    PdfExportCommand
    Export command that writes a telemetry session using the PDF export strategy.
    PdfExportStrategy
    Exports telemetry sessions as a two-page PDF report containing compilation, activity, error-frequency, and class/method progression information.
    SessionAnalytics
    Calculates aggregate and event-based analytics for telemetry sessions.
    TelemetryCollector
    Collects published telemetry events by adding them to a telemetry session.
    TelemetryEvent
    Represents one recorded telemetry event, including its category, timestamp, display details, and optional source-location or execution information.
    TelemetryExtension
    BlueJ extension entry point that collects telemetry, registers BlueJ event listeners, provides manual export, and performs a final export on shutdown.
    TelemetryMenu
    Provides the BlueJ Tools menu entry that queues a telemetry export.
    TelemetryObserver
    Observer for telemetry events published by a telemetry subject.
    TelemetrySession
    Stores a student's telemetry session, including its time range, registered projects, and collected telemetry events.
    TelemetrySubject
    Maintains telemetry observers and publishes events to each registered observer in registration order.
